rationale: The captured context from MAA/RN/2025/04 directly supports the claim. Paragraph 13 establishes that where compliance cannot be demonstrated due to lack of suitable AI standards or AI unpredictability, the Air System Safety Case approach remains valid using verification (trials, testing, analysis) and continuing performance monitoring. The accompanying notice text and region excerpt confirm the position that resolving these issues is not currently possible prescriptively without architectural mitigation.
limitations: The notice provides UK military aviation guidance for systems subject to MRP design assurance; it is not a civil aviation approval or an exhaustive demonstration of compliance.
